practiceQuestions.q: Which of the following Indian cities was recently designated as India's first UNESCO 'City of Literature' under the UNESCO Creative Cities Network (UCCN)?
practiceQuestions.sol: Kozhikode in Kerala was officially designated as India's first UNESCO 'City of Literature' in 2023 under the UNESCO Creative Cities Network (UCCN) initiative, recognizing its rich literary heritage and vibrant publishing culture. [Primary Reference: UNESCO Creative Cities Network Official Guidelines / Ministry of Culture, Government of India]

practiceQuestions.q: Which historical monument in India was recently inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2023, making it the 41st World Heritage property in India?
practiceQuestions.sol: Santiniketan, founded by Maharshi Debendranath Tagore and later expanded by Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore, was inscribed as India's 41st UNESCO World Heritage Site in September 2023 during the 45th session of the World Heritage Committee. [Primary Reference: Archaeological Survey of India / UNESCO World Heritage Centre]

practiceQuestions.q: The Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas, which became India's 42nd UNESCO World Heritage Site, are located in which state?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas (comprising the Chennakesava Temple at Belur, Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu, and Keshava Temple at Somanathapura) are located in Karnataka and were inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list in September 2023. [Primary Reference: Archaeological Survey of India / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q: Which traditional Indian performing art form was inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in December 2023?
practiceQuestions.sol: The ritualistic and vibrant dance form 'Garba' from Gujarat was inscribed as India's 15th intangible cultural heritage element on the UNESCO Representative List during the 18th session of the Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage in Kasane, Botswana, in December 2023. [Primary Reference: Sangeet Natak Akademi / UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage]

practiceQuestions.q: The 'Pradhan Mantri Sangrahalaya', recently inaugurated in New Delhi, is a museum dedicated to which of the following?
opts: Only the first Prime Minister of India, Jawaharlal Nehru
All former Prime Ministers of India
The freedom struggle and tribal leaders
practiceQuestions.sol: The Pradhan Mantri Sangrahalaya built at the Teen Murti Estate in New Delhi is a tribute to every Prime Minister of India since Independence, documenting their contribution to the nation-building process irrespective of political ideology. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Culture, Government of India / Nehru Memorial Museum and Library]

practiceQuestions.q: Which initiative was launched by the Ministry of Culture to map every village in India to document local arts, crafts, traditions, and cultural assets?
practiceQuestions.sol: The 'Mera Gaon Meri Dharohar' (My Village My Heritage) initiative is a nationwide project under the National Mission for Cultural Mapping, executed by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA), aiming to comprehensively document cultural identity across 6.5 lakh villages in India. [Primary Reference: National Mission for Cultural Mapping, Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q: What is 'Yuge Yugeen Bharat', which has been in recent news regarding India's museum landscape?
opts: A digital portal for purchasing traditional Indian handicraft goods globally
The upcoming largest museum in the world showcasing 5,000 years of Indian history
A high-speed train network connecting major cultural heritage pilgrimage sites
A pan-India classical dance competition organized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi
practiceQuestions.sol: The 'Yuge Yugeen Bharat National Museum' is planned at the North and South Blocks of the Central Secretariat in New Delhi. Once completed, it will be the world's largest museum, showcasing India's glorious 5,000-year history and civilizational journey. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Culture, Government of India / Central Vista Redevelopment Project]

practiceQuestions.q: The term 'Vande Mataram Symphony' or recent cultural renditions often relate to which cultural body established under the Ministry of Culture?
practiceQuestions.sol: Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's national academy for music, dance, and drama, frequently orchestrates mega cultural events, classical performances, and symphonies (such as regional and national musical tributes) under the aegis of the Ministry of Culture. [Primary Reference: Sangeet Natak Akademi Annual Report / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q: Which initiative was undertaken by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) to enable seamless online booking and virtual 360-degree tours of protected monuments across India?
opts: Visitor SYNC and ASI Ticket Booking Portal / Mobile App
practiceQuestions.sol: The ASI has modernized monument access through dedicated digital booking portals and applications, allowing tourists to purchase e-tickets, view monument guides, and access digital content to promote digital tourism in heritage sites. [Primary Reference: Archaeological Survey of India / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q: The 'Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar' is awarded annually by which autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture?
practiceQuestions.sol: The Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar is conferred by the Sangeet Natak Akademi to outstanding young artists up to the age of 40 years in the fields of music, dance, drama, and folk/tribal arts. [Primary Reference: Sangeet Natak Akademi Guidelines / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q: How does the inclusion of properties in the UNESCO Creative Cities Network (UCCN) fundamentally alter the paradigm of cultural preservation compared to conventional physical monument conservation?
opts: It shifts focus from static architectural preservation to dynamic, living creative economies, urban regeneration, and community-led cultural practices.
It replaces archaeological excavations entirely with modern urban real estate development.
It restricts local artisanal communities from commercializing their traditional crafts to preserve authenticity.
It transforms cultural sites exclusively into protected zones prohibiting public habitation.
practiceQuestions.sol: Unlike physical World Heritage Sites which emphasize strict architectural conservation and preservation of historical fabric, the UCCN focuses on leveraging creativity, literature, crafts, music, or gastronomy as a strategic factor for sustainable urban development, fostering local economies and empowering creative communities. [Primary Reference: UNESCO Creative Cities Network Framework / NCERT Art Education Principles]

practiceQuestions.q: What is the primary rationale behind the Government of India's recent shift toward establishing thematic museums (such as PM Sangrahalaya, Tribal Freedom Fighters Museums, and Partition Horrors Remembrance Museum) rather than general history museums?
opts: To minimize public expenditure on architectural maintenance by building smaller facilities.
To employ immersive storytelling, experiential technology, and decentralized narratives to engage younger demographics and correct historical omissions.
To phase out traditional archaeological museums managed by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).
To restrict museum curation solely to post-independence political history.
practiceQuestions.sol: Recent museum policies emphasize experiential learning, cutting-edge digital integrations (VR/AR), and thematic depth. This approach bridges historical gaps by highlighting unsung heroes, regional freedom struggles, and collective memories, making history engaging and accessible to contemporary audiences. [Primary Reference: National Policy on Museums / Ministry of Culture Strategic Vision]

practiceQuestions.q: How does the 'National Mission for Cultural Mapping' (NMCM) contribute to India's contemporary cultural ecosystem?
In the context of recent repatriations of stolen and smuggled antiquities to India, what is the significance of the 1970 UNESCO Convention?
opts: It mandates the immediate financial compensation by colonial powers for historical looting.
It provides the international legal framework for prohibiting and preventing the illicit import, export, and transfer of ownership of cultural property.
It gives exclusive jurisdiction to the International Court of Justice over all domestic heritage disputes.
It automatically transfers the ownership of all foreign artifacts found in India to UNESCO.
practiceQuestions.sol: The 1970 UNESCO Convention on the Means of Prohibiting and Preventing the Illicit Import, Export and Transfer of Ownership of Cultural Property is a foundational international instrument utilized by India in bilateral negotiations and diplomatic outreach to successfully repatriate hundreds of stolen idols and ancient artifacts from countries like the US, Australia, and UK. [Primary Reference: Archaeological Survey of India / UNESCO 1970 Convention]

practiceQuestions.q: Why has the geographical indication (GI) tag certification seen a massive surge for traditional art and craft products in India in recent years?
opts: To exempt traditional artisans from paying Goods and Services Tax (GST) permanently.
To legally protect indigenous intellectual property, prevent cultural appropriation, and boost export market credibility for authentic rural crafts.
To nationalize the production of all handicrafts under state-owned industrial corporations.
To replace the UNESCO Intangible Heritage listings with domestic GI protections.
practiceQuestions.sol: GI tags protect the unique geographical origin and traditional manufacturing methods of artisanal products, preventing unauthorized commercial exploitation, counterfeiting, and cultural misappropriation while empowering local craft communities economically. [Primary Reference: Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999 / Ministry of Commerce and Industry]

practiceQuestions.q: How does the 'PM VIKAS' (Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman) scheme integrate with the preservation and evolution of traditional Indian arts and crafts?
What is the cultural significance of India's nomination of 'Maratha Military Landscapes' for UNESCO World Heritage inscription?
opts: It highlights medieval military architecture, strategic hill-fort systems, and indigenous naval defense doctrines developed during the 17th to 19th centuries.
It honors the British colonial cantonments established in the Deccan region.
It seeks to convert historic battlefields into commercial tourist amusement parks.
It commemorates exclusively the diplomatic treaties signed between Marathas and European powers.
practiceQuestions.sol: The Maratha Military Landscapes of India showcase an extraordinary system of fortification, military strategy, and topography integration (hill, forest, and coastal sea forts like Raigad, Sindhudurg, and Shivneri) reflecting the genius of Maratha military engineering and statecraft. [Primary Reference: Archaeological Survey of India / UNESCO Tentative Lists]

practiceQuestions.q: How do recent developments in the promotion of 'Classical Languages' in India impact the linguistic and cultural policy landscape?
opts: They lead to the replacement of modern scheduled languages in primary education.
They reinforce civilizational continuity, foster academic research in ancient manuscripts, and provide institutional funding for classical literature preservation.
They restrict the use of regional dialects in administrative and judicial proceedings.
They mandate all citizens to learn at least three classical languages.
practiceQuestions.sol: The conferment of 'Classical Language' status (recently extended to additional languages like Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, Marathi, and Bengali) acknowledges their antiquity, rich literary heritage, and independent literary tradition, triggering central grants for professorships, manuscript digitization, and academic research. [Primary Reference: Ministry of Education guidelines / Cabinet Decisions on Classical Languages]

practiceQuestions.q: What is the significance of the recent integration of 'AI and Digital Archives' (such as National Digital Library of India and e-Manuscripta projects) in Indian cultural heritage management?
opts: It facilitates remote access, automated translation, preservation of fragile manuscripts, and crowdsourced documentation of oral traditions.
It aims to physically destroy original historical paper manuscripts after scanning.
It restricts museum entry exclusively to AI software programmers and data scientists.
It replaces physical archaeological excavations with algorithmic satellite mapping.
practiceQuestions.sol: Digital archiving and AI deployment allow for the high-resolution preservation, optical character recognition (OCR) of ancient scripts, automated translation, and global accessibility of rare cultural manuscripts and museum artifacts, democratizing access to India's heritage. [Primary Reference: National Mission for Manuscripts / Ministry of Culture Digital Initiatives]

practiceQuestions.q: How do the 'Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat' initiative and national cultural festivals (like Rashtriya Sanskriti Mahotsav) alter the cultural dynamics of modern India?

Consider the following statements regarding the UNESCO Creative Cities Network (UCCN):
1. The network covers seven creative fields including Crafts and Folk Art, Design, Film, Gastronomy, Literature, Media Arts, and Music.
2. No Indian city has ever been included in this network under any category.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: The UCCN covers seven distinct creative fields. Statement 2 is incorrect because multiple Indian cities are part of the network, including Jaipur (Crafts and Folk Art), Varanasi (Music), Chennai (Music), Mumbai (Film), Hyderabad (Gastronomy), and Kozhikode (Literature). [Primary Reference: UNESCO Creative Cities Network Official Portal / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding recent UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India:
1. Santiniketan in West Bengal was inscribed as a World Heritage Site in 2023.
2. The Hoysala Temples in Karnataka (Belur, Halebidu, and Somanathapura) were inscribed as serial property World Heritage Sites.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. Santiniketan (India's 41st site) and the Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas (India's 42nd site, comprising multiple monuments as serial properties) were officially inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list in September 2023. [Primary Reference: Archaeological Survey of India / UNESCO World Heritage Committee]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'National Mission for Manuscripts' (NMM):
1. It is an autonomous body functioning directly under the Ministry of Defence.
2. Its objective is to document, conserve, and digitize the vast manuscript wealth of India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is incorrect because the National Mission for Manuscripts operates under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India (launched in 2003). Statement 2 is correct: its prime mandate is to unearth, document, conserve, and digitize India's estimated 10 million manuscripts spread across institutions and private collections. [Primary Reference: National Mission for Manuscripts / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding India's Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) inscriptions:
1. Garba of Gujarat is the most recent Indian element to be inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
2. The Sangeet Natak Akademi acts as the nodal agency in India for matters relating to the UNESCO ICH convention.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. Garba was inscribed in December 2023, becoming India's 15th ICH element. The Sangeet Natak Akademi, an autonomous body of the Ministry of Culture, serves as the nodal agency for formulating dossiers and coordinating ICH safeguarding with UNESCO. [Primary Reference: Sangeet Natak Akademi / UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Programme]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the PM Vishwakarma scheme:
1. It is a Central Sector Scheme providing financial support, skill upgradation, and toolkit incentives to traditional artisans and craftspeople.
2. The scheme is implemented exclusively by the Ministry of Culture.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme providing comprehensive support to artisans. Statement 2 is incorrect because the scheme is jointly implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, and the Department of Financial Services. [Primary Reference: Ministry of MSME / Union Cabinet Decisions]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI):
1. It is attached to the Ministry of Culture and is the premier organization for archaeological researches and protection of cultural heritage.
2. The ASI was established during the British colonial period under the direct initiative of Alexander Cunningham.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are correct. The ASI functions under the Ministry of Culture and is statutorily responsible for the maintenance of ancient monuments and archaeological sites of national importance under the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (AMASR) Act, 1958. It was founded in 1861 with Alexander Cunningham as its first Director-General. [Primary Reference: Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958 / ASI Official Records]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding Geographical Indication (GI) tags in India:
1. A GI tag is granted under the Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS) Agreement administered by the World Trade Organization (WTO).
2. Once granted, a GI registration is valid forever without any requirement of renewal.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Both statements are incorrect. Statement 1 is incorrect because while TRIPS sets international standards, domestic GI tags in India are governed by the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999 (enacted to comply with WTO obligations). Statement 2 is incorrect because GI registration is valid for only 10 years and can be renewed periodically for further periods of 10 years. [Primary Reference: Geographical Indications of Goods Act, 1999 / Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA):
1. It is the premier art gallery under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, with its main campus at New Delhi.
2. It houses paintings exclusively by foreign European artists who visited India during the colonial era.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: NGMA is premier art repository under the Ministry of Culture with branches in New Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru. Statement 2 is incorrect because NGMA primarily houses and exhibits modern and contemporary Indian art spanning from the 1850s onwards, featuring masters like Rabindranath Tagore, Amrita Sher-Gil, M.F. Husain, and Jamini Roy, alongside select international works. [Primary Reference: National Gallery of Modern Art / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sahitya Akademi:
1. It is India's national academy of letters, recognizing literary works in the 22 languages enumerated in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India plus English and Rajasthani.
2. It was established as a statutory body by an act of Parliament in 1990.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: Sahitya Akademi recognizes literature in 24 languages (22 scheduled languages plus English and Rajasthani). Statement 2 is incorrect because the Sahitya Akademi was established by a resolution of the Government of India (Ministry of Education) in March 1954, and is registered as a society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, not as a statutory act of Parliament in 1990. [Primary Reference: Sahitya Akademi Constitution / Ministry of Culture]

practiceQuestions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Mera Gaon Meri Dharohar' project:
1. It is a joint initiative of the Ministry of Culture and Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) to culturally map India's villages.
2. The project limits its scope exclusively to archaeological monuments protected under the ASI, ignoring intangible folk traditions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
practiceQuestions.sol: Statement 1 is correct: Mera Gaon Meri Dharohar is a cultural mapping project implemented by IGNCA under the Ministry of Culture. Statement 2 is incorrect because the project specifically focuses on comprehensive village profiling, capturing both tangible and intangible heritage including local traditions, folk arts, agriculture practices, festivals, and community identity across 6.5 lakh villages. [Primary Reference: National Mission for Cultural Mapping / IGNCA Official Portal]
